name: FactorLab: Quantitative Factor Investing
description: Interactive simulation where participants allocate capital across equity factors (value, momentum, quality, size, low-volatility) through varying economic regimes, discovering that individual factors are cyclical but a disciplined multi-factor approach delivers more stable risk-adjusted returns.
